title: Review image quality and artefacts
description: Inspect visible geometry, anatomy, text, reflections, edges and reference fidelity.
accomplishes: Inspect visible geometry, anatomy, text, reflections, edges and reference fidelity. Separate confirmed defects from subjective preferences. Prioritise local corrections while preserving the intended composition and disclose details that cannot be verified.
prompt:
Act as an art director.

Task: Review image quality and artefacts.

Input context:
- IMAGE: [IMAGE]
- INTENDED USE: [INTENDED USE]
- REFERENCE: [REFERENCE]
- EDIT LIMITS: [EDIT LIMITS]

Inspect visible geometry, anatomy, text, reflections, edges and reference fidelity. Separate confirmed defects from subjective preferences. Prioritise local corrections while preserving the intended composition and disclose details that cannot be verified.

Specify composition, lighting, framing, style, desired resolution and aspect ratio. Preserve authorised references and identify details requiring human review.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Product-image review
Check whether the cup handle connects naturally, the rim is coherent and the logo follows the surface. Compare material and proportions with the source before changing style. Fix one local issue at a time and inspect the result again. This checklist does not imply that an actual image has been reviewed or corrected.
